tools.name: resolve_fragment
tools.description: Pieces together the name of a film, TV or radio show, song, book, game, quote, person, place, event or research study from the fragments a user remembers: a scene, a line, a face, roughly when. Pass every fragment in the user's own words, even uncertain ones. It searches many sources and fits them t

tools.name: submit_resolution_feedback
tools.description: After the user reacts to a resolve_fragment result, call this with its resolution_id. accepted: it is what they meant. partial: it helped but is not quite it. rejected: it is not what they meant. If they recognised an item in the shortlist or leads, send picked_rank (1 = first item) or picked_url; i

tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description:
Checks whether current web sources support a specific factual assertion. Takes a claim as a natural-language statement; returns a verdict with cited evidence and stated limits.

Verdict set:
- "supported" — multiple independent sources directly confirm the specific claimed detail
- "partially_suppor

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "resolve_fragment" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
